shots.say: Create an event with automatic attendance tracking, using QR codes.
shots.caption: Events with QR check-in

shots.say: Tap Create Event. Fill in the basics: name, date, time, and location.
shots.caption: Create Event → the basics

shots.say: Every event gets its own check-in QR code. There's nothing to switch on. In Check-In Settings, pick the Check-In Window: Flexible, Strict, or Window.
shots.caption: Check-In Window: Flexible, Strict or Window

shots.say: Save the event. The QR code is ready straight away.
shots.caption: Save — the QR code is ready

shots.say: Print this QR code, or show it on a tablet at the door.
shots.caption: Print it, or show it at the door

shots.say: When members arrive, they scan the code, sign in if they need to, and tap Check In to This Event.
shots.caption: Members scan and tap Check In

shots.say: Their screen says You're Checked In. No more paper sign-in sheets. No more chasing people down after the event.
shots.caption: You're Checked In
